title: fix(plugin-auth): Set Manager refuses only a person a SCIM directory holds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

Fixes #33200
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 「设置上级」(Set Manager) 现在只拒绝真正由 SCIM 目录同步的人；只通过 SSO 登录、背后没有目录的人，管理员可以照常改上级。按钮对平台管理员在每一行用户上都显示。
- **为什么改：** 托管环境里第一次通过平台 SSO 登录的人都会被标成 `idp_provisioned`，旧规则把他们全当成「目录持有」，登录后上级就再也改不了，按上级流转的审批跟不上组织调整。按裁决记录 6895645364 选项 A 修。
- **风险与回滚：** 只放宽：以前能成功的请求没有一个变成拒绝。SCIM 判定多读一次 `sys_scim_subject`，读失败返回 500 且不写入。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `admin-set-user-manager.ts` 的 refusal 5 判断（`applyUserManagerLink`）；`scim-sso-adoption.ts` 新导出的 `isHeldByScimDirectory`；`sys-user.object.ts` 的 `set_user_manager` `visible`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/admin-set-user-manager.test.ts`，预期 38 个全过，其中 "an SSO-only identity ... is SET like a local one" 为 200 并写入 `manager_id`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Built to the maintainer ruling recorded in 6895645364 (option A: only identities a SCIM directory holds stay locked).

- **`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager` (refusal 5).** It refused on `sys_user.source = 'idp_provisioned'` alone. ADR-0135 D4 stamps that value on every federated link without a local password, so a person who only signs in through SSO carried it with no directory behind them. The refusal now also needs a `sys_scim_subject` row. The answer for a SCIM-held identity keeps its envelope (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, `details.reason: 'idp_provisioned'`), and the message says to change the manager in the directory. It no longer claims a sync would revert the value, because nothing projects the SCIM `manager` attribute onto the column today. The self, cycle, depth and cross-organization refusals are unchanged.
- **One predicate, imported.** `scim-sso-adoption.ts` now exports `isHeldByScimDirectory(engine, userId)`. It is the same `sys_scim_subject` read its adoption judge already ran as condition 2, moved into an exported function. The judge calls it, and so does the endpoint. A missing `sys_scim_subject` table reads as "not held" at the endpoint. Any other read failure propagates, so the mount answers 500 and writes nothing.
- **The `source` term stays a conjunct.** A SCIM-provisioned user with a local password is `env_native` under D4 and was accepted before. Requiring the SCIM row alone would have refused that user, so the endpoint still checks `source` too, and no request that was served before is refused now.
- **Bulk import and demo staff.** Both run `applyUserManagerLink`, so their `manager_id` links follow the same rule with no code change. The import docblock now says who is refused.
- **`sys_user.set_user_manager` visibility** is `current_user.isPlatformAdmin == true`. No column on the row says "held by SCIM", so the button is shown on every row and the endpoint refuses a SCIM-held one with its message. No new field or key.
- **Lint prescription.** `os explain approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` now says the operation refuses an identity a SCIM directory holds, and that an identity that only signs in through SSO is set like any other. The docblock in `validate-approval-approvers.ts` says the same.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`, `content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` state the narrowed refusal.
- ⛔ The `idp_provisioned` stamp (ADR-0135 D4) and the password refusals are untouched.

## Tests

On head `fa70eaa06`:

- `admin-set-user-manager.test.ts`, refusal 5 rewritten. SCIM-held SET and CLEAR give 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `idp_provisioned`, write nothing, and read `sys_scim_subject` for that user. SSO-only SET and CLEAR give 200, and `update` gets `{ id, manager_id }`. An SSO-only self-assignment is still a 400 `self_assignment`. `env_native` gives 200, also with a SCIM subject, and the SCIM table is not read. A missing table gives 200. A failed read rejects and writes nothing.
- `admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts`: a SCIM-held row is refused with `idp_provisioned`. An SSO-only row is `linked`, and `manager_id` is written. The no-fork pin also asserts that the importer spells neither `sys_scim_subject` nor `isHeldByScimDirectory`.
- `demo-staff.test.ts`: the refusal fixture is now a SCIM-held identity.
- `sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts` and `platform-objects.test.ts`: the action is offered on an `idp_provisioned` row and on the sparse face. It is hidden from a non-admin. It reads no record column, which has a positive control on the standing term.
- `validate-approval-approvers.test.ts`: the new prescription is present, and the old `source 'idp_provisioned'` sentence is absent.

<details><summary>Suite runs</summary>

- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` full suite (locked, before the demo-staff fixture fix): 276/277 files. The one red was `demo-staff.test.ts`, whose fixture is fixed in the next commit. Re-run: `demo-staff.test.ts` + `demo-staff-provisioning.test.ts` 32/32.
- Targeted: plugin-auth 3 files 76/76; platform-objects 2 files 169/169; lint 1 file 64/64.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects` full: 122 files, 1994 tests passed. `@objectstack/lint` full: 212 files, 9026 tests passed.
- Typecheck exit 0 for plugin-auth (all three legs, incl. `check:test-typecheck`), platform-objects and lint.
- Dependent: `@objectstack/runtime` `platform-admin-action-gate.test.ts` 16/16.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation landed by ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- A1, refuse on `source` alone (the old predicate): 7 red, incl. every SSO-only pin in both endpoint and import suites.
- A2, no refusal 5 at all: 4 red, incl. SCIM-held SET, CLEAR and the import row.
- A3, refuse on the SCIM row alone (drop the `source` conjunct): 1 red, "env_native ... even one that owns a SCIM subject".
- A4, swallow every SCIM read failure: 1 red, "a FAILED SCIM-subject read is never read as no directory".
- A5, put the `record.source` term back on `visible`: 5 red across `sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts` and `platform-objects.test.ts`.
- A6, put the old lint sentence back: 1 red, "GRADES the routes".
- A7, missing table rethrows: 1 red, "a missing sys_scim_subject table means no directory".

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- SCIM-held users stay unchangeable from both sides until the SCIM `manager` projection lands. The ruling records this and the separate card #33918 carries it.
- The action's `helpText` still lists the four other refusals and not the SCIM one. The endpoint message names the directory. Changing `helpText` would move nine translation bundles, so it is left as it is.
- `details.reason` keeps the value `idp_provisioned` so no client keyed on it changes. Only the predicate behind it narrowed.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 105 derived families. 101 exit 0. 3 exit 3 (prerequisite not met, NOT MEASURED, left to CI): `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`. 1 not run: `check:type-check-debt`, because the verify lock was held by another run for more than 60 minutes. `--ran` reconciliation agrees.
- `--tier`: no path-derived mandate. The same verdict as merged #33646 and #33769.
- eslint on the changed `.ts` files: exit 0. `check-nul-bytes`: OK.
